promotion_note: Promoted 2026-07-25 (miso-88): the 2026-07-24-miso-86-netrev-margin keeper form replayed byte-faithfully (gas_offer_margin=true, carry_operating_mothballs=true, outages on the CAMPD unit-level derate) with a SINGLE delta that is a DATA CORRECTION, not a mechanism or a flag: the eGRID plant-heat-rate boundary reconciliation. eGRID keys PLNT23 on ORISPL, but CEMS reports co-located plants sharing a stack under one facilityId, so where that happens the plant row's heat input PLHTIAN spans the whole CEMS facility while its net generation PLNGENAN covers only the one EIA plant. Riverside Energy Center (55641, MISO-East) is the live instance: PLHTIAN 53,017,211 MMBtu is byte-identical to the CAMPD heatInput sum over all four units of facility 55641 -- the 2004 Riverside block AND the 2020 West Riverside block (EIA 64020, 454 m away) -- while PLNGENAN 3,543,044 MWh is the 674.9 MW Riverside plant alone; eGRID's own UNT23 sheet dates the two surplus units to 2019 against EIA-860 vintages of 2004, and 64020 reports the same machines independently. The published 14.964 MMBtu/MWh is ~2x any combined cycle and priced the plant near $45/MWh against ~$20/MWh for its class -- above most MISO coal -- so the LP never committed it (model CF 0.01/0.05/0.01 vs actual 0.60/0.57/0.56). Reconciled to 6.880 from eGRID's own unit rows, cross-validated three independent ways. ZERO degrees of freedom; rule 11's named boundary-mismatch exception, reconciled rather than guessed. Accepted under four conditions, the last self-validating, which is what rejects the two would-be false positives (Devon 544, King City 10294); across all six ISOs the accepted set is exactly {55641: 6.880} and the verified blast radius is 3 rows / 1 plant / MISO only. A general form was sized and REFUSED (47 plants touched, 25 destroyed). RESULT: closes the keeper's sole load-bearing VOLUME fail -- C1 fuel-mix FAIL -> PASS, with CC_REGULAR improving in all three years (2023 -6.71 -> -4.99 TWh, 2024 -2.09 -> -0.42, 2025 -6.14 -> -4.19). Determination stays NOT-YET but on ONE fail instead of two: C3b-2025 price shape (NRMSE 0.204 -> 0.208, veto <=0.20). Both worsened price crossings (C3b, and the ledgered C3a-2025 caveat widening -14.8% -> -16.6%) were PRE-REGISTERED in the charter before solving as the arithmetic consequence of returning 534.8 MW of cheap CC to the merit order, and are KEPT per rules 1/11 -- the accurate input stays in even though it worsens the fit, and the worse fit is a discovered-bug signal to root-cause in the 2025 summer-body price lane (FINDING-miso87-c3b-summer-2025-body-2026-07.md), never to be offset with a tuned adder. Promoted on STRUCTURAL FIDELITY (rule 1: the keeper is the most faithful run, not the lowest MAE), since the superseded keeper carries a provably wrong measured heat rate. Rule 22 LOO: the correction has zero DOF and one value identical in every year, so nothing is year-specific to overfit, and the C1 gain is uniform across 2023/2024/2025. Full span in ONE bundle (rule 16). Charter: docs/handoffs/miso-88-egrid-hr-boundary-plan-2026-07.md. Supersedes 2026-07-24-miso-86-netrev-margin (same recipe + this input correction).
